stages: Native edit/newline, undo/redo and Mod-S write real UTF-8 text while preserving BOM, CRLF and permissions
Production editor Find/Replace and goto-line shortcuts operate on the actual text
Save failure retains changes; input during a held real save remains dirty and saves against the new disk version
External writes preserve local text; comparison shows exact versions and refuses an outdated overwrite
Deleted files retain editable recovery text; explicit use-disk resolution discards only by user choice
Closing an unsaved file supports Escape cancellation and save-before-close
Close-other-files cancellation and save protect the selected dirty tab and write only the closing files
Project switch cancellation, durable keep, recovery failure blocking and identical-path project isolation
Partial large files stay read-only; native renderer reload checkpoints and restores unsaved text
Quit waits for the exact unsaved recovery checkpoint before the first Electron process exits
A separate Electron process restores exact unsaved text, base version, pinned tab and disk isolation
Native close cancellation and explicit discard remove recovery without writing disk

boundary: Two separate offline Electron processes using production preload/files IPC, native Chromium keyboard/mouse, real APFS files and durable application recovery records.
